label: LoRa PHY with a bounded hypothesis grid
about: Select a frame region and supply its first data-symbol offset, SF and bandwidth. An optional preceding upchirp provides a frequency reference. Timing, drift and bin-bias grids are finite; matching a header or parity does not establish an application protocol. Absent payload CRC and conflicting best payloads remain candidates. The input samples/chip ratio must be 1, 2, 4, 8 or 16. All grid-selection observations remain in provenance; no automatic device identification.
data_offset_samples: First data symbol / samples from selection start
use_reference: Use a preceding upchirp frequency reference
reference_offset_samples: Reference upchirp / samples from selection start
drift_step: Drift grid step / bins per symbol
correct_single_bit: Allow bounded FEC correction and erasure reconstruction
stage.hypothesis: Finite timing, drift and bias hypotheses
sequence.peaks: Observed peaks: metric is fractional bin
sequence.hypothesis: Chosen representative hypothesis and global inputs
sequence.corrected: Decoded codewords: metric is observed bit distance
sequence.bytes: Candidate PHY payload and CRC bytes
conclusion.hypothesis: Representative within the declared grid. Provenance includes the reference and observations used to choose it.
conclusion.ambiguous: Best hypotheses disagree or the best-candidate set exceeded its limit. Conflicting bytes are unknown; no unique payload is established.
conclusion.no_header: No usable frame hypothesis was found within this grid. FFT and coding evidence are retained.
frame.label: LoRa PHY candidate
frame.scope: PHY checks under the declared symbol grid, header mode and bounded correction policy. A payload CRC is distinct from application validation; protocol, business and device identity remain unknown.
field.application_unknown: Application protocol, business and device unknown
issue.parameter: Enter an allowed value for the complete LoRa configuration.
issue.unknown: This LoRa provider does not declare the supplied parameter.
issue.clock: Use a channel rate with 1, 2, 4, 8 or 16 input samples per LoRa chip.
issue.grid: Grid endpoints and timing radius must lie on their finite steps and stay within the hypothesis budget.
issue.reference: Place the reference upchirp before the first data symbol within this selection.
issue.partial_symbol: Only part of this symbol is inside the selected input.
issue.missing: Required input contains a gap or unknown continuity boundary.
issue.low_power: Normalized RMS is below the supplied threshold.
issue.diffuse_peak: The folded peak does not meet the supplied concentration threshold; it is not a calibrated SNR.
issue.reference_unknown: The frequency-reference upchirp has no accepted peak.
issue.symbol_erasure: The corresponding symbol decision is unknown.
issue.word_erasure: Some received codeword bits are unknown; inspect the known-bit mask.
issue.fec_unknown: No unique accepted codeword is established under this correction policy.
issue.parity_failed: A codeword check failed. Systematic-bit candidates are retained without claiming a strict frame.
issue.corrected: A unique bounded-distance codeword correction was applied; the received word is retained.
issue.reconstructed: An erased codeword bit was reconstructed under the declared distance condition.
issue.partial_byte: Only one nibble of this byte is available.
issue.byte_erasure: At least one nibble has no accepted decision.
issue.ambiguous_payload: Best hypotheses disagree on this byte or best-candidate enumeration is incomplete.
